ITEM 8.01. Other Events.
On October 27, 2026, Las Vegas Sands Corp. (the “Company”) and Sands China Ltd., the Company’s majority-owned subsidiary, issued a press release to announce that Sands China Ltd. has priced $700 million of 6.400% senior notes due 2032 and $300 million of 6.700% senior notes due 2033. The press release is attached as Exhibit 99.1 and is herein incorporated by reference.
heads.EX-99.1:
EXHIBIT 99.1
SANDS CHINA ANNOUNCES PRICING OF
$1.0 BILLION OF SENIOR UNSECURED NOTES
LAS VEGAS, October 27, 2026 - Las Vegas Sands Corp. (NYSE: LVS) today announced that its majority-owned subsidiary, Sands China Ltd. (“Sands China”), has priced $700 million of 6.400% senior notes due 2032 and $300 million of 6.700% senior notes due 2033. The offering is expected to close on November 3, 2026, subject to customary closing conditions.
Sands China intends to use the net proceeds of approximately $989 million from the offering and cash on hand to redeem in full the outstanding principal amount of its US$700 million 2.300% senior notes due 2027 and any accrued interest, repay the outstanding balance on its 2024 SCL Revolving Facility and for general corporate purposes, including capital expenditures.
